This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure for Digital Creators at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide-4. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure for Digital Creators

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

The COREMERCH Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) and Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offer two different levels of sovereign commerce infrastructure for digital creators. The Sovereign Starter Stack provides a basic infrastructure setup with GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. The Edge Commerce Stack, on the other hand, offers a more advanced infrastructure setup with Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Supabase for order storage, and Google Drive for file delivery. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all the necessary blueprints and templates to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. With these options, digital creators can own and operate their own infrastructure, free from the risks of platform suspension, account freezing, and data ownership.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Both the COREMERCH Sovereign Starter Stack and Edge Commerce Stack are designed to work in regions where Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle are unavailable or severely restricted. The stacks use NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, which allows digital creators to receive payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, including popular options like Bitcoin and Ethereum. This means that digital creators can sell their digital products in these regions without being locked out of their own store. Additionally, the stacks use free hosting services like GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages, which eliminates the need for expensive hosting plans or account upgrades.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

The payment speed and fees associated with the COREMERCH Sovereign Starter Stack and Edge Commerce Stack are competitive with other payment processors. The stacks use NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, which has a fee of 0.5% per transaction. This is lower than many other payment processors, which can charge fees ranging from 2.9% to 5.9% per transaction. Additionally, the stacks use free hosting services like GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages, which eliminates the need for expensive hosting plans or account upgrades. This means that digital creators can save money on payment processing fees and hosting plans, and still receive fast payment processing times.
Digital creators can sell their digital products in over 300 cryptocurrencies with the COREMERCH Sovereign Starter Stack and Edge Commerce Stack.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

The COREMERCH Sovereign Starter Stack and Edge Commerce Stack offer digital creators full ownership and control over their store infrastructure, including their customer list, order history, and product files. The stacks are designed to automate payment processing, order fulfillment, and delivery, which eliminates the need for manual intervention and reduces the risk of human error. Additionally, the stacks use free hosting services like GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages, which ensures that digital creators have complete control over their store's technical infrastructure.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The COREMERCH Sovereign Starter Stack and Edge Commerce Stack are designed to meet the needs of different digital creators. The Sovereign Starter Stack is a good option for digital creators who need a basic infrastructure setup and are on a budget. The Edge Commerce Stack, on the other hand, is a good option for digital creators who need a more advanced infrastructure setup and are willing to invest in their store's technical infrastructure. Ultimately, the choice between the two stacks will depend on the specific needs and goals of the digital creator.
What does sovereign commerce infrastructure mean for digital creators?

What's the most important thing a digital creator should know about sovereign commerce infrastructure? The most important thing is that it allows digital creators to own and operate their own store infrastructure, free from the risks of platform suspension, account freezing, and data ownership. This means that digital creators have complete control over their customer list, order history, and product files, which is essential for building a successful online business.
